title: Neptune: An AI model for Global Ocean Subseasonal Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.08606v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Subseasonal-to-seasonal (S2S) forecasting is societally critical, supporting decision-making in sectors ranging from water and agricultural management to disaster risk reduction, energy planning, and insurance. Achieving reliable predictions at these timescales requires representing the ocean and its dynamics, but traditional physics-based Ocean General Circulation Models (OGCMs), are computationally expensive and difficult to develop and improve because of the code complexity. In this work, we propose Neptune, an end-to-end data-driven framework for global ocean and sea-ice components emulation tailored for S2S timescales, up to 60 days. Neptune combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Spherical Fourier Neural Operators (SFNOs) to effectively capture local features and global cross-scale interactions, thereby obtaining a coherent representation of the ocean state. translated_title: Neptune：一个用于全球海洋次季节预测的AI模型
translated_abstract: 次季节到季节（S2S）预报对社会至关重要，支持从水资源和农业管理到灾害风险降低、能源规划和保险等各个领域的决策。要在这些时间尺度上实现可靠预测，需要对海洋及其动力学过程进行表征，但传统的基于物理的海洋环流模型（OGCM）计算成本高昂，且由于代码复杂而难以开发和改进。在这项工作中，我们提出了Neptune，一个针对次季节尺度（长达60天）设计的端到端数据驱动框架，用于全球海洋和海冰分量的模拟。Neptune结合了卷积神经网络和球面傅里叶神经算子，以有效捕捉局部特征和全球跨尺度相互作用，从而获得海洋状态的连贯表征。在给定的每日大气场强迫下，Neptune模拟……
tldr: Neptune是一个结合卷积神经网络与球面傅里叶神经算子的端到端数据驱动AI框架，能够实现长达60天的全球海洋与海冰次季节预测，为传统高成本物理海洋环流模型提供了高效替代方案。
en_tdlr: Neptune is an end-to-end data-driven AI framework combining CNNs and Spherical Fourier Neural Operators that enables global ocean and sea-ice subseasonal prediction up to 60 days, offering an efficient alternative to computationally expensive physics-based ocean circulation models.
